metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2022 · Buried in Barstow
metas.description: Follows Hazel King, a single mother determined to protect her daughter from the life she once had while defending and protecting those who can't protect themselves.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2023 · The Childe
metas.description: "The Childe" focuses on a man born to a Korean father and a Filipino mother who aspires to be a boxer. He travels back to Korea in the hopes of tracking down his father, and in the process, he gets mixed up with some bad people.
